races.paceDynamic: Mont St Michel stands alone as the confirmed front-runner and will set an uncontested lead in this large field maiden hurdle. With no genuine pace pressure, he can dictate terms and kick clear when ready, creating a tactical advantage over the field. The prominent racers like Colcannon, Newbrook Diamond and Mossy Way will track him in the early positions, while the majority of this 28-runner field are hold-up horses who will need the pace to collapse. This race shape strongly favours the early position horses who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems and benefit from the sustainable gallop that Mont St Michel will provide.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Mont St Michel gets an easy lead and maintains his jumping rhythm
scenarios.body: He can dictate the gallop and have enough left to resist the late challengers in the testing ground. The lack of pace pressure allows him to conserve energy for a decisive move approaching the last.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the class horses settle prominently and time their challenge perfectly
scenarios.body: Colcannon or Newbrook Diamond can stalk Mont St Michel before producing superior finishing speed in the final furlong. Their higher ratings and proven form give them the edge in a sustained battle.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes unsustainable despite Mont St Michel's lone lead
scenarios.body: The race becomes a scramble where a classy hold-up horse like Splendid Fellow can weave through traffic and capitalize on the leaders' fatigue. His class and De Bromhead's training edge become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Outsider Shocks
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders fail to handle the large field dynamics and testing conditions
scenarios.body: A lightly-raced improver or unconsidered runner benefits from the chaotic pace and finds significant improvement from their previous efforts. The maiden hurdle format often produces surprises when class horses disappoint.

watchPoints.text: Mont St Michel's jumping rhythm early - if he makes mistakes at the early hurdles his uncontested lead advantage disappears completely
Traffic problems in the straight with 28 runners - hold-up horses like Splendid Fellow and Chopsticks could get trapped behind faltering leaders
Colcannon's position turning for home - if he's caught wide or too far back he'll struggle to use his superior class rating
Brother Walfrid's market support given he's unraced - any significant money would suggest Elliott knows he has ability
The pace through the first mile - if Mont St Michel goes too fast early the race could collapse and favour the hold-up horses

races.paceDynamic: Green Hope, Maverick Mack, Umpire's Call, and Frankie's Freebie will ensure a strong gallop from the outset, with 9 prominent runners creating a cavalry charge behind them. The pace will be honest throughout on this yielding to soft ground, testing stamina reserves over 2m4f. This strong gallop and prominent congestion heavily favours hold-up horses who can avoid the early traffic and produce sustained finishing kicks from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuine and prominent runners get caught in traffic 2-3 out
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will set up perfectly for patient riders to sweep up late, with the soft ground aiding their sustained finishing kicks. Hold-up specialists with proven stamina will have clear runs while the pace-setters and prominent runners tire.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Survives Traffic
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can secure a clear run and avoid the mid-race squeeze
scenarios.body: The race will still be run at a strong clip but a well-positioned prominent runner with tactical pace can kick clear approaching the final flight. This requires perfect positioning from an experienced jockey.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the leaders go steady early and avoid a punishing gallop throughout
scenarios.body: Green Hope or Maverick Mack could dictate terms and kick again when challenged, especially if the ground rides slower than expected. This scenario requires the pace-setters to be more tactical than usual.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos and Longshot Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If multiple fallers or a pile-up occurs at a crucial hurdle with the field bunched
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with horses getting hampered or brought down, allowing an outsider with a clear passage to capitalize. Stamina becomes less relevant than avoiding trouble.

watchPoints.text: Watch for carnage at the third-last hurdle when 9 prominent runners converge after being held up behind the strong early pace
Monitor Green Hope and Maverick Mack for signs of rust given their lengthy absences of 41 and 127 days respectively
Observe how apprentice jockey Harry Sexton handles Frankie's Freebie in the early pace battle with experienced riders
Check if Aurea Fortuna gets the patient ride his hold-up style requires with Philip Byrnes needing to resist following the strong gallop
Watch for Zam Bobbler and Don Jefe improving significantly for the drop in class with their claiming jockeys taking off valuable pounds

races.paceDynamic: Leader d'Allier, Heads Up, Ebony King and Murat will all want to lead, creating a fierce early battle and strong gallop throughout this 2m Grade 2. With four confirmed front runners in an 8-runner field, the pace will be genuinely run from flag to finish, testing stamina reserves on the yielding to soft ground. The relentless gallop will stretch the field and create gaps, making it difficult for hold-up horses to make up ground in the straight. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can sit just off the pace battle and horses with proven stamina at this trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Battle Collapses Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If the four front runners go too fast early and burn each other out
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will find out the leaders' stamina reserves, allowing prominent tracker Blake or hold-up specialist Koktail Brut to pick up the pieces. Jack Kennedy's timing on Koktail Brut could be decisive if the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader d'Allier Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Paul Townend can get Leader d'Allier into an early lead and control the fractions
scenarios.body: The Mullins horse has the class and stamina to sustain a strong gallop and kick clear, with his recent Leopardstown win showing his current form. His proven stamina at this trip gives him the edge over the other pace-setters.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Blake Times Run Perfectly
scenarios.trigger: If Donagh Meyler can settle Blake prominently behind the pace battle
scenarios.body: The Noel Meade-trained horse can use his tactical speed to strike at the perfect moment when the leaders tire. His recent good form and prominent style suits this likely strong gallop perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Heads Up Stays Strongest
scenarios.trigger: If Sean Bowen can get Heads Up into a good rhythm and avoid the early pace battle
scenarios.body: The six-year-old's excellent record on similar going gives him a chance if he can stay out of trouble early. His stamina will be tested by the expected strong pace but his class could see him through.

races.paceDynamic: Oldschool Outlaw, How's Hannah, Highland Crystal and Future Prospect will create a fierce early gallop with Charme De Faust and Good Girl Kathleen also keen to press forward. This strong pace will stretch the field through the middle sections, testing stamina reserves over this demanding 2m4f trip on yielding ground. The gallop should be honest throughout with multiple pace angles engaged from the start. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses and prominent racers with proven stamina who can pick up the pieces when the early leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the six confirmed front-runners engage in a pace duel through the early stages
scenarios.body: The honest gallop will drain the speed horses, allowing patient types like Carrigmoornaspruce and A Path To Ronda to sweep past tired leaders in the final half-mile. Hold-up specialists with class will profit most from this energy-sapping scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Mullins Tactical Masterclass
scenarios.trigger: If Willie Mullins' multiple runners allow How's Hannah or Future Prospect to dictate ideal fractions
scenarios.body: The team tactics could produce a more measured pace that suits the versatile prominent racers like Place De La Nation and Bambino Fever who can track the pace and quicken. The stable's numerical advantage becomes decisive with better-positioned runners.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Highland Crystal Class Tell
scenarios.trigger: If the Gordon Elliott-trained mare can overcome her front-running style and travel strongly through honest fractions
scenarios.body: Her Grade 1 class and progressive profile could see her sustain a strong gallop better than rivals, with Mange Tout tracking her move. The best horses simply outclass the field despite tactical disadvantages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners surprisingly moderate the early pace due to tactical restraint
scenarios.body: Late closers like Louve D'Irlande and Diamond Du Berlais could find themselves in the hunt when stamina becomes less crucial. This unlikely scenario would completely change the complexion and allow outsiders into contention.

races.paceDynamic: Karamoja is the sole confirmed front-runner and will set a sustainable gallop without pressure from the break. The prominent racers (Jigoro, Birdie Or Bust, Break My Soul, Moudan, More Coko, Relieved Of Duties) will track in behind but none are natural pace pressers. With 8 of 13 runners adopting hold-up tactics, the first half will be run at a moderate tempo before accelerating from 3 out. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce finishing kicks, as they'll get the easy pace they need to wind up late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Karamoja sets an uncontested lead and the pace stays moderate throughout
scenarios.body: The prominent trackers get outpaced when the tempo lifts, leaving the patient hold-up brigade with plenty left in the tank. The closing sectional becomes crucial as multiple finishers converge.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.body: They get first run on the field before the hold-up horses can organize their challenges. The moderate early pace suits but they need to time their move perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Karamoja Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the leader gets an easy time of it and finds extra when challenged
scenarios.body: The front-runner's class tells as the chasers struggle to reel in the sustained gallop. Mullins' 31-day break could have him spot-on.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate tempo becomes pedestrian and turns into a sprint
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure speed test over the final 3 furlongs where tactical position matters less. The best raw speed horses benefit from the sit-and-sprint finish.

races.paceDynamic: Sixmilebridge, Jacob's Ladder, Predators Gold and Pure Steel will all want the early lead in this small field, creating a genuine pace battle from the start. The four confirmed front-runners will establish a strong gallop that should see the pace hold up throughout, particularly on this yielding to soft ground which can test stamina reserves. This honest pace will set up the race perfectly for those capable of tracking the leaders and finishing strongly, with the hold-up horses like Western Fold and Jimmy Du Seuil getting the tactical advantage they need. The race shape strongly favours prominent trackers and hold-up horses who can capitalise on the strong early pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Holds
scenarios.trigger: If all four front-runners engage early and maintain a solid gallop to the home turn
scenarios.body: The strong pace will find out the stamina reserves of the leaders, allowing the classier hold-up horses to sweep past in the closing stages. Western Fold and Jimmy Du Seuil are perfectly positioned to exploit this scenario with their proven finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters gets first run and the others don't respond quickly enough
scenarios.body: Jacob's Ladder or Sixmilebridge could steal a decisive advantage by getting the jump on their pace rivals and maintaining enough in reserve. Their recent form suggests they have the class to make all if getting the right breaks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If the multiple front-runners neutralise each other or one takes a clear early lead uncontested
scenarios.body: Without a true test of stamina, the race becomes more about pure speed and class from the home turn onwards. This brings prominent runners like Kappa Jy Pyke and Kala Conti right into the equation with their superior ratings.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos at the Start
scenarios.trigger: If jumping errors or interference disrupts the early pace battle among the front-runners
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with those who get clear runs and avoid trouble holding all the aces. Any of the field could benefit if they get the right passage while others struggle with the ground or jumping.

races.paceDynamic: Final Demand, Kitzbuhel, Kaid d'Authie, Salvator Mundi, Jacob's Ladder, Predators Gold, Sixmilebridge and Downmexicaway will ensure a relentless gallop from the start in this 28-runner cavalry charge. The sustained pace over 2m4f on testing ground will stretch the field and expose stamina limitations, particularly with multiple Mullins-trained pace-setters likely to take turns in front. Western Fold and Romeo Coolio's prominent tactics should keep them in touch, but the prolonged gallop will set up a war of attrition in the closing stages. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses with proven stamina reserves who can unleash late kicks when the early pace-setters capitulate.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If the strong gallop maintains throughout and pace-setters weaken approaching the final fence
scenarios.body: The relentless tempo will stretch stamina limits and create perfect conditions for closers to sweep past tiring leaders in the final 2f. Western Fold's class and Jimmy Du Seuil's finishing kick become decisive weapons.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Romeo Coolio or Koktail Divin can secure ideal positions behind the pace without getting involved in early battles
scenarios.body: Their tactical positioning allows them to avoid the worst of the early pace while staying close enough to strike when leaders weaken. Superior fitness and tactical racing proves the difference.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leading quartet finds a second wind while rivals capitulate from the sustained gallop
scenarios.body: Kaid d'Authie or Final Demand's superior class allows them to outlast fellow pace-setters and repel late challengers. Mullins' strength in depth creates the perfect sacrifice scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the brutal pace eliminates most fancied runners and an outsider benefits from the chaos
scenarios.body: The collapse of multiple favourites opens the door for a well-handicapped runner like Sixmilebridge to capitalise on ideal racing weight. Fergal O'Brien's patient placement pays dividends.

races.paceDynamic: Five Star Getaway will get an uncontested lead with no other natural front-runners in this field. City Chief, Big Interest, Solitary Man, Stuzzikini, Asphalt Cowboy, Wrappedupinmay and Now Where Or When will create a packed prominent group, leading to inevitable traffic problems and positioning battles from the home turn. The pace will be sustainable early but the congestion behind the leader will create a messy, stop-start finish. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can avoid the early scrimmaging and find clear runs late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack gets tangled up from 3 out as expected
scenarios.body: The sustainable early pace allows closers to conserve energy while the packed prominent group suffers interference and positioning issues. Hunters Yarn and Chemical Energy can pick off tired horses with clear late runs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader stays clear
scenarios.trigger: If Five Star Getaway maintains a big enough lead to hold the closers
scenarios.body: The 12-year-old gets first run on tired legs and the chasing pack leaves their moves too late after getting caught up in traffic. His recent form suggests he can stay this trip when given rope.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent horse finds room
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners gets a dream run through the congestion
scenarios.body: They can capitalize on the slow early pace to outkick both the tired leader and the hold-up horses still making ground. Solitary Man's class edge makes him the most likely beneficiary.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Five Star Getaway goes too slow and the field stays bunched throughout
scenarios.body: It becomes a cavalry charge finish where anything can win in a blanket finish. The handicapper's dream scenario where ratings matter more than running styles.
